name: Bigthan and Teresh
title: Conspiring Court Officials
summary: Bigthan and Teresh were two of King Ahasuerus's court officials who guarded the doorway. They conspired together to lay hands on the king, but their plan was uncovered by Mordecai and reported through Queen Esther. Both were executed, and the event was recorded in the king's chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Conspiracy Against the King
keyEvents.description: Bigthan and Teresh, who guarded the doorway, became angry and sought to lay hands on King Ahasuerus. They planned an assassination against the Persian king.

keyEvents.title: Mordecai's Revelation
keyEvents.description: Mordecai learned of the conspiracy and informed Queen Esther, who in turn told the king in Mordecai's name.

keyEvents.title: The Execution
keyEvents.description: The matter was investigated and found to be true. Both conspirators were hanged on a gallows, and the event was written in the book of chronicles for the king to see.

keyEvents.title: The Event Remembered in the King's Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Later, during a sleepless night, King Ahasuerus had the book of chronicles read to him and was reminded how Mordecai had exposed Bigtan and Teresh. This led to Mordecai's elevation.
